messages:
alex r: quick async standup — GPU capacity & quotas check
alex r: what I did: validated AZ allocations in us-west-2, scaled staging pool +4 g4dn nodes, ran a capacity audit for europe regions
alex r: blocker: p4d quota is 0 in eu-west-1 (blocking a customer canary); autoscaler occasionally reports negative pending capacity in staging-gpu-2 (flaky metric)
alex r: today: open quota request with cloud, follow up on autoscaler metric bug, coordinate temporary burst if AWS times out
maria s: quick q — which workload would hit p4d in eu-west-1? is it the realtime-infer pipeline or a specific canary?
jing wu: realtime-infer canary is the one. I reproduced the negative pending capacity locally — looks like a race when freeing KV caches during evict. Pushed extra guard logs to staging.
calvin t: I checked service quotas: `aws service-quotas get-service-quota --service-code ec2 --quota-code L-ABC123 --region eu-west-1` => Value: 0. Opened case with AWS (case 123456).
calvin t: also ran `aws ec2 describe-instances --filters Name=instance-type,Values=p4d.24xlarge` to confirm none provisioned in that account/region.
tanvi p: opened partner AZ request to allow a one-off burst while quota is pending (CLOUD-879). If AWS times out we can route canary to us-west-2 for now.
capacity-bot: autoscaler alert — allocation anomaly in staging-gpu-2 at 2026-03-16T09:12Z. Link: https://alerts.internal/alloc-334. Suggested check: `kubectl get nodes -l pool=staging-gpu-2 -o wide`
alex r: action items: @maria s check canary routing + fallback to us-west-2; @jing wu add per-AZ metric tags and increase guard on KV eviction; @calvin t keep AWS case updated; @tanvi p follow partner burst and update cloud ticket
maria s: on it — will validate canary config and post results by EOD
jing wu: PR pushed for extra logs and guard: refs/changes/PR-792, added unit test to reproduce race
calvin t: AWS replied asking for account usage details, I provided region+expected sustained vCPU and justification
tanvi p: partner confirmed potential AZ burst for 6 hrs if needed, waiting on formal approval
alex r: thanks all — if anyone sees the autoscaler alert again ping with `alloc-334` and include node dump. I'll consolidate notes for on-call handoff later. :thumbsup:
capacity-bot: note — next scheduled capacity-sync job runs in ~45m (job id: sync-20260316-10)
